description: Call this tool when the user needs a place that is safe for a specific allergy or diet near a location — for example "where can my celiac kid eat near Brickell tonight". Input Requirements (CRITICAL): `location` MUST be `{latitude, longitude}`; `needs` MUST list one or more of `gluten_free`, `dairy_free`, `nut_aware`, `vegetarian` (AND semantics). Returns a `pack` of at most 3 human-curated places ranked by kitchen mechanism (`dedicated`, then `strong_protocol`, then `shared_verify`), each with `safety_label`, `allergy_safety_note`, `open_now`, and `curator_checked_at` (the curator's newest source check backing the tier; null if unknown). `left_out` is the cut line: how many places were looked at and why the rest are not shown (`no_curated_evidence`, `curated_for_other_needs`, `beyond_pack_size`, `closed_now`); you MUST tell the user how many were looked at and left out. When `pack` is empty, you MUST relay `empty_state` and `next_steps` instead of filling the gap from other sources or unverified dietary tags. NEVER describe a result as "verified safe"; say the tier label and `allergy_disclaimer`. For a quotable signed statement about one place, call `get_safety_attestation` with its `id`. Attribute grounded output using `citation` or `attribution`.

location.description: Where the user is or will be (Google-style nested latitude/longitude).

needs.description: Allergy needs the place must be curated for, AND semantics. One or more of: gluten_free, dairy_free, nut_aware, vegetarian.

open_now_only.description: When true, places closed right now are left out and counted in left_out.reasons.closed_now.

radius_miles.description: Default 12 (curated allergy places are sparse). Max 20.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for open-now evaluation. Default America/New_York.

name: find_safe_places_near_me
